desc: Derive and validate parity-DSU seam indexing and the exact local A/B constraints, including degenerate toroidal dimensions.
Implement the O(HW) parity union-find solver, detect contradictions, and compute the number of free components modulo 998244353.
Prove that local constraints are equivalent to tile orientations and that each consistent DSU component contributes exactly one binary degree of freedom.
Specify Python memory/I/O details suitable for total grid size 10^6.
